title: Ambiguous Mission language is clarified in the interviewee's terminology

persona.name: Kian
persona.brief: Use the team's terms green and cleared, and explain that they are different states.

mission.objective: Learn when a payment is released.
mission.desired_outcome: Clarify the Mission term released against the interviewee's operational vocabulary.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the terminology before changing payment status labels.

shared_mission_entries.detail: The Investigator's current label for a payment that has passed checking.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: Does released mean the same thing as the team's payment status?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: Status labels must not collapse distinct operational events.
investigation_results.relevant_context: The Mission uses released; the payments team may use another term.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The meanings of the Mission term and the team's terms are explicitly distinguished or aligned.

answer.text: We call a checked payment green. I am not sure what you mean by released.

turns.sourceQuestion: What has happened when your team calls a payment green?

answer.text: Green means a checker has finished. We only say cleared after the funds have left, so green and cleared are different. Nobody here says released.
